sentences.japanese: 可能な限りの手段を講じろ。
別の手立てを講じるだろう。
非行者に対して強硬な対策を講じるべきだ。
sentences.english: Strong measures should be taken against wrong doers.

sentences.japanese: 日本政府は不況対策を講じる事になるだろう。
sentences.english: The Japanese government will take measures to counter depression.

sentences.japanese: 適切なときに適切な措置を講ずるべきです。
sentences.english: You should take the appropriate measures at the appropriate time.
